hurdle_gate.hard_fail_reason: MDD 51.6% > 45% threshold (pure factor baseline, no overlay)
hurdle_gate.note: Pure factor baseline (S1). S5 mutations achieve Grade A: SR 1.080, CAGR 16.09%, MDD 29.8% with RP+DD+Regime overlay.

gate_0_hard_fail.detail: Pure baseline MDD 51.6% > 45% = HARD FAIL. But S5 best variant (RP+DD+Regime) MDD 29.8% = PASS. Turnover not available in sim_result but buffer_zone 50/25 implies moderate turnover.

c1_full_sample.detail: align_factor_direction() uses full-sample mean(IC) to determine factor sign. However, for C19/V14/D01, direction is theory-consistent (PEAD/Value/LowVol). Sign is binary and extremely stable. Not a hard violation but should migrate to expanding-window IC sign in future.

c2_same_day_circular.detail: No VT/DD overlay in baseline. AvgTV20 uses shift(n=1) lag for liquidity filter.

c3_period_aggregation.detail: Score weights are FIXED (50/30/20), not data-derived. No period aggregation applied.

c4_financial_lag.detail: Factor DB handles accounting data lag internally via compute modules.

c5_overlay_lag.detail: No overlay in pure baseline. S5 DD/Regime overlays are t-1 by design.

c9_dd_vt_lag.detail: No DD/VT in pure baseline. S5 uses dd_lag pattern per C9 rule.

c11_fred_timing.detail: No FRED data used. Factor DB uses domestic data only.

c13_z_score_aligned.detail: Line 17 loads Z_Score, line 21 calls align_factor_direction() which creates Z_Score_Aligned, line 47 dcasts on Z_Score_Aligned. No manual NEGATE/FLIP_SIGN.

c14_usable_date.detail: Loop line 41: valid_fdb <- fdb_dates[fdb_dates <= sig_d]. Only uses factor data available at or before signal date.

c15_load_month_factors.detail: Uses direct open_dataset() instead of load_month_factors(). But applies equivalent PIT logic (fdb_dates <= sig_d) and align_factor_direction(). Functionally PIT-safe but should use canonical path.

gate_1_pit_audit.factor_weight_determination: FIXED weights (C19=50%, V14=30%, D01=20%). No optimization, no IC-based weighting in baseline. S5 tested dynamic weights but fixed won.

ic_stats.note: ICIR 0.593 >> 0.20 threshold. IC t-stat 9.43 >> 3.0 Harvey threshold.

fmb_regression.note: FMB t=6.31 (NW) >> 3.0 Harvey. Score factor has independent pricing power after controlling for Size and Momentum.

rolling_sharpe.note: 82.5% of rolling 1Y windows have positive Sharpe. Robustness strong.

stress_tests.note: 3/4 crisis outperformance. COVID underperformance noted (smallcap value drag).

dsr.note: compute_dsr() not available in current environment. Recommend batch DSR computation.

gate_2_statistical_defense.harvey_t_check: FMB t=6.31 > 3.0 = PASS. IC t=9.43 > 3.0 = PASS.

gate_3_orthogonality.note: max_corr=0.30 vs 268 factors. Partial independence expected since C19 is 50% of blend. Score blend creates distinct signal through cross-factor interaction.

gate_4_marginal_contribution.note: Delta SR +0.547 over KOSPI. Substantial marginal contribution. Role: core_alpha.

gate_5_final_grade_and_role.role_honesty: CLEAN — Score blend combines earnings quality + value + defense. Genuine core alpha, not disguised defense.
strengths: Fixed weights = zero optimization risk, maximum robustness
Score blend solves sleeve correlation problem (L-484)
22 S5 mutations with 6 categories = thorough exploration
weaknesses: Pure baseline MDD 51.6% (hard fail without overlay)
align_factor_direction uses full-sample IC sign (low severity advisory)
S5 best MDD 29.8% still above 25% target
